description: For the GUEST of a plan or their assistant. Judge each option against what your person wants and send only a verdict (ok | veto | unknown) and optional rank (1 = best) per option, and ok per time window. Never send reasons, diet, budget or anything else; there is no field for them. The other person sees only the final proposal. Args: { plan_id, token, answer: { options: [{ id, verdict, rank? }], windows?: [{ id, ok }] } }. No auth required.

answer.description: Verdicts and ranks only. There is no field for a reason: never put preferences anywhere.

common_options.description: PRIVATE-VENUES plans, owner side: the option ids both accept, computed from psi_guest_venues_reply. Sent on its own; not a revision.

common_windows.description: PRIVATE-TIMES plans, owner side: the window ids you computed as shared from psi_guest_reply (life: prefs.private_times_resolve). Sent on its own; not a revision.

options.description: One verdict per option; rank 1 = best among the ok ones. An option left out counts as unknown, never ok.

id.description: An option id from the plan.

verdict.description: ok, veto (rules it out, never attributed) or unknown (never counted as ok).

psi.description: PRIVATE-TIMES plans, guest side: the PSI reply from lib/plans/psi guestStep, sent INSTEAD of windows.

blinded.description: Your own free windows, blinded, in any order.

items.description: A blinded value: 64 hex characters (the x coordinate of a P-256 point).

double.description: The owner's blinded windows, blinded again by you, in the same order.

items.description: A blinded value: 64 hex characters (the x coordinate of a P-256 point).

psi_venues.description: PRIVATE-VENUES plans, guest side: the PSI reply over the options you ACCEPT (ids prefixed 'v:'), sent instead of verdicts.

blinded.description: The options you accept ('v:<id>'), blinded, in any order.

items.description: A blinded value: 64 hex characters (the x coordinate of a P-256 point).

double.description: The owner's blinded options, blinded again by you, in the same order.

items.description: A blinded value: 64 hex characters (the x coordinate of a P-256 point).

windows.description: Which time windows work. Not sent on private-times plans.

id.description: A window id from the plan.

plan_id.description: The plan id (pl_...), from ic_plans_create or ic_plans_list.

token.description: The guest link token: the t= value in the plan link the guest was sent.

name: ic_plans_guest_answer
title: Answer a plan you were invited to: verdicts and ranks only
